mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MY_ITEM WHERE HOMEPAGE_ID = #{homepage_id} AND MEMBER_KEY = #{member_key}

SELECT A.HOMEPAGE_ID, A.MEMBER_KEY, A.STORAGE_IDX, A.ITEM_IDX, A.ITEM_NAME, A.AUTHOR, A.PUBLER, A.LOCA, A.CTRL_NO, A.CALL_NO, A.IMG_URL, A.ADD_DATE, A.ITEM_TYPE, B.STORAGE_NAME FROM MY_ITEM A INNER JOIN MY_STORAGE B ON A.MEMBER_KEY = B.MEMBER_KEY AND A.HOMEPAGE_ID = B.HOMEPAGE_ID AND A.STORAGE_IDX = B.STORAGE_IDX WHERE A.HOMEPAGE_ID = #{homepage_id} AND A.MEMBER_KEY = #{member_key} ORDER BY A.STORAGE_IDX
